name: Pond Grid
description: A grid of cells like a still pond: clicking a cell sends a ring of light outward across the grid.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Side of a cell, in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the water: the ripple, the hover tint and the borders that catch the ring. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Colour of the hairlines between cells.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Tint the cell under the pointer and start a ripple on click. Clicks on links, buttons and fields above the grid stay with them.

props.name: idle
props.description: Let a raindrop land on a random cell every few seconds and start a smaller ripple. Off under reduced motion.

props.name: onCellClick
props.description: Called with the clicked cell, counted from the top left of the grid. Pointer only: the grid is decoration and takes no keyboard focus, so anything that matters needs its own control.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the grid. Other div props are passed through.
